g.text: DCT v3.13: recorded training variants — ten-cohort coverage
Five-fold best-validation C-index; UNI2-h; seed 3. Red: first; underline: second among available variants.
Exp4/Exp5 retain weight 0.025; Full uses 0.05 each. These historical recipes are not pure matched-weight removals.
NR: missing variant results. Ten-cohort mean is shown only for a complete row; single-entry columns are not ranked.
